mapper.sql: select p.id, p.user_id, p.wx_openid, p.script_id, p.script_title, p.current_episode, p.current_panel, p.history_choices_json, p.current_stats_json, p.is_finished, p.finish_score, p.finish_box_office, p.last_shoot_time, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, u.nickname, u.user_name from dj_user_progress p left join dj_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where p.user_id = #{userId} and p.script_id = #{scriptId} and p.del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into dj_user_progress ( user_id, wx_openid, script_id, script_title, current_episode, current_panel, history_choices_json, current_stats_json, is_finished, finish_score, finish_box_office, last_shoot_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{wxOpenid}, #{scriptId}, #{scriptTitle}, #{currentEpisode}, #{currentPanel}, #{historyChoicesJson}, #{currentStatsJson}, #{isFinished}, #{finishScore}, #{finishBoxOffice}, sysdate(), '0', #{createBy}, sysdate() ) on duplicate key update script_title = values(script_title), current_episode = values(current_episode), current_panel = values(current_panel), history_choices_json = values(history_choices_json), current_stats_json = values(current_stats_json), is_finished = values(is_finished), finish_score = values(finish_score), finish_box_office = values(finish_box_office), last_shoot_time = sysdate(), update_by = values(create_by), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update: update dj_user_progress set current_episode = 1, current_panel = 0, history_choices_json = '[]', current_stats_json = '{"pleasure":10,"drama":25,"anger":10,"evidence":0,"subversion":0}', is_finished = '0', finish_score = null, finish_box_office = null, last_shoot_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and script_id = #{scriptId} and del_flag = '0'
update dj_user_progress set del_flag = '2' where id = #{id}
